title: CLIP-FMoE: Scalable CLIP via Fused Mixture-of-Experts with Enforced Specialization
abstract: arXiv:2611.30233v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a promising approach for scaling deep learning models while maintaining computational efficiency. However, existing MoE adaptations for Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) models suffer from significant computational overhead during sequential training and degradation of zero-shot capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose CLIP-FMoE, a novel approach that integrates MoE architecture into CLIP fine-tuning. Our method uses Isolated Constrained Contrastive Learning, a pipeline that trains specialized experts on cluster-based data partitions to accelerate expert specialization. Additionally, we introduce a Fusion Gate mechanism to mitigate catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves consistent improvements on downstream tasks while preserving zero-shot capabilities. Furthe

translated_title: CLIP-FMoE：通过强制专业化的融合专家混合实现可扩展的CLIP
translated_abstract: 混合专家架构已成为在保持计算效率的同时扩展深度学习模型的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的针对对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）模型的MoE适配方法在顺序训练过程中存在显著的计算开销，并且零样本能力会出现退化。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了CLIP-FMoE，这是一种将MoE架构集成到CLIP微调中的新方法。我们的方法采用隔离约束对比学习，这是一种在基于聚类的数据分区上训练专门专家以加速专家专业化的训练流程。此外，我们引入了融合门机制来缓解对预训练知识的灾难性遗忘。在多个基准测试上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在下游任务上取得了一致的改进，同时保留了零样本能力。此外……
tldr: 本文提出CLIP-FMoE，通过隔离约束对比学习加速专家专业化、并利用融合门机制缓解灾难性遗忘，将混合专家架构集成到CLIP微调中，在提升下游任务性能的同时保留了零样本能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CLIP-FMoE, which integrates Mixture-of-Experts into CLIP fine-tuning using Isolated Constrained Contrastive Learning to accelerate expert specialization and a Fusion Gate mechanism to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, achieving consistent downstream improvements while preserving zero-shot capabilities.
